title: Document your own function
hints: Follow the order of a cppreference page: signature, description, parameters, return value, complexity, example (lesson 1.02).
Decide what `split("", ",")` returns and write it down; either answer is fine if the docs say it.
requirements: A header comment with: what it does, parameters and preconditions, return value, complexity and one example.
An implementation that does exactly what the comment says, including empty parts and empty input.
A test for each sentence of the comment.
stretch: Ask someone else to use the function from the comment alone and note what they got wrong.
